# Director lifecycle

## Primary Director lifecycle

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph LIFECYCLE_DIRECTOR["Director"]
        direction TB
        D_OPEN["Open intent and bind Director"]
        D_Q1(["Receive and answer Q1 only"])
        D_Q2(["Receive and answer Q2 only"])
        D_Q3(["Receive and answer Q3 only"])
        D_Q4(["Receive and answer Q4 only"])
        D_Q5(["Receive and answer Q5 only"])
        D_Q6(["Receive and answer Q6 only"])
        D_WALK["Walk through the frozen candidate"]
        D_DECIDE{"Ratify the exact candidate?"}
        D_FEEDBACK["Correction or withholding recorded"]
        D_DONE(["Intent captured; planning handoff sealed"])
    end
    subgraph LIFECYCLE_PROPOSER["Proposer / Survey agent"]
        direction TB
        P_INIT["Resolve dependencies and initialize"]
        P_R1["Design, validate, and freeze Round 1"]
        P_R1_INTERPRET["Interpret and seal Round 1"]
        P_R2["Design Round 2 from sealed Round 1"]
        P_R2_INTERPRET["Interpret and seal Round 2"]
        P_COMPOSE["Compose the immutable candidate"]
        P_CLASSIFY{"Classify actionable feedback"}
        P_SCOPE_LINK["Earlier scope change: linked run required"]
    end
    subgraph LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME["Substrate / Runtime"]
        direction TB
        R_VALIDATE{"Mechanically validate candidate"}
        R_FINALIZE["Deterministically render terminal envelope"]
        R_FINAL_CHECK{"Verify terminal projection result"}
        R_ANCESTRY_LINK["Earlier invalid ancestor: linked run required"]
    end
    D_OPEN -->|"Bind intent and complete initialization"| P_INIT
    P_INIT -->|"Begin Round 1 design"| P_R1
    P_R1 -->|"Save, freeze, and present Q1"| D_Q1
    D_Q1 -->|"Accept Q1; then present Q2"| D_Q2
    D_Q2 -->|"Accept Q2; then present Q3"| D_Q3
    D_Q3 -->|"Complete and begin interpreting Round 1"| P_R1_INTERPRET
    P_R1_INTERPRET -->|"Save and seal Round 1; begin Round 2"| P_R2
    P_R2 -->|"Save, freeze, and present Q4"| D_Q4
    D_Q4 -->|"Accept Q4; then present Q5"| D_Q5
    D_Q5 -->|"Accept Q5; then present Q6"| D_Q6
    D_Q6 -->|"Complete and begin interpreting Round 2"| P_R2_INTERPRET
    P_R2_INTERPRET -->|"Save and seal Round 2; compose"| P_COMPOSE
    P_COMPOSE -->|"Save and seal candidate"| R_VALIDATE
    R_VALIDATE -->|"Validation failed; repair candidate"| P_COMPOSE
    R_VALIDATE -->|"Validation passed; begin walkthrough"| D_WALK
    D_WALK -->|"Acknowledge and show next segment"| D_WALK
    D_WALK -->|"All segments acknowledged"| D_DECIDE
    D_DECIDE -->|"Ratify exact candidate and finalize"| R_FINALIZE
    D_DECIDE -->|"Return correction or withhold"| D_FEEDBACK
    D_FEEDBACK -.->|"Classify actionable feedback"| P_CLASSIFY
    P_CLASSIFY -->|"Composite-only revision"| P_COMPOSE
    P_CLASSIFY -->|"Round 2 reinterpretation"| P_R2_INTERPRET
    P_CLASSIFY -.->|"Earlier change requires a linked run"| P_SCOPE_LINK
    D_FEEDBACK -->|"Clarify while still unratified"| D_FEEDBACK
    D_FEEDBACK -->|"Withdraw withholding; decide again"| D_DECIDE
    R_FINALIZE -.->|"Classify terminal projection"| R_FINAL_CHECK
    R_FINAL_CHECK -->|"Transient retry"| R_FINALIZE
    R_FINAL_CHECK -->|"Candidate ancestry invalid"| P_COMPOSE
    R_FINAL_CHECK -->|"Round 2 ancestry invalid"| P_R2_INTERPRET
    R_FINAL_CHECK -.->|"Earlier invalid ancestor requires linked run"| R_ANCESTRY_LINK
    R_FINAL_CHECK -->|"Seal handoff and close runtime"| D_DONE
    D_Q1 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q1 only"| D_Q1
    D_Q2 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q2 only"| D_Q2
    D_Q3 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q3 only"| D_Q3
    D_Q4 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q4 only"| D_Q4
    D_Q5 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q5 only"| D_Q5
    D_Q6 -.->|"Invalid response; repeat Q6 only"| D_Q6
```

## Continuity, abort, and fail-safe handling

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph CONTINUITY_DIRECTOR["Director"]
        direction TB
        D_CURRENT["Current disclosed item only: exact re-emission"]
    end
    subgraph CONTINUITY_RUNTIME["Substrate / Runtime"]
        direction TB
        R_START["Open or restart a persisted run"]
        R_REHYDRATE["Rehydrate and verify"]
        R_ACTIVE["Active at an exact committed cursor"]
        R_PAUSED["Suspended"]
        R_RECOVERABLE["Recoverable block"]
        R_TERMINAL(["Terminal block; linked run required"])
        R_REJOIN["RJM01 resolves exact node and legal continuation"]
        R_CONTINUE["Continue at the mapped lifecycle step"]
        R_ANY["Any verified nonterminal run"]
        R_ABORTED(["Aborted; no planning handoff"])
        R_UNVERIFIABLE["Session cannot be verified"]
        R_QUARANTINED(["Quarantined; linked run only"])
    end
    R_ANY -->|"Abort verified run; close without handoff"| R_ABORTED
    D_CURRENT -->|"Re-emit exact current item only"| D_CURRENT
    R_START -->|"Open session and begin verification"| R_REHYDRATE
    R_ACTIVE -->|"Process restart re-verifies persisted state"| R_REHYDRATE
    R_REHYDRATE -->|"Restart verification after interruption"| R_REHYDRATE
    R_PAUSED -->|"Resume explicitly"| R_REHYDRATE
    R_RECOVERABLE -->|"Retry with resolution evidence"| R_REHYDRATE
    R_REHYDRATE -->|"Verification passed"| R_ACTIVE
    R_ACTIVE -.->|"Resolve exact persisted lifecycle point"| R_REJOIN
    R_REJOIN -.->|"Resume mapped node and legal continuation"| R_CONTINUE
    R_REHYDRATE -->|"Recoverable verification failure"| R_RECOVERABLE
    R_REHYDRATE -->|"Terminal verification failure"| R_TERMINAL
    R_ACTIVE -->|"Pause at committed boundary"| R_PAUSED
    R_ACTIVE -->|"Required dependency failed"| R_RECOVERABLE
    R_ACTIVE -->|"Semantic-scope or integrity terminal"| R_TERMINAL
    R_UNVERIFIABLE -.->|"Quarantine without fabricating an event"| R_QUARANTINED
    class D_CURRENT director
    class R_START,R_REHYDRATE,R_ACTIVE,R_PAUSED,R_RECOVERABLE,R_TERMINAL,R_REJOIN,R_CONTINUE,R_ANY,R_ABORTED,R_UNVERIFIABLE,R_QUARANTINED runtime
    classDef director fill:#eef4ff,stroke:#315a9b,color:#111
    classDef proposer fill:#eefaf2,stroke:#397a4a,color:#111
    classDef runtime fill:#fff7e8,stroke:#9a6b24,color:#111
```

## Reading the projection

- Solid arrows are lifecycle macros; their transition IDs are fully traced to the normative protocol FSM.
- Dashed arrows are views, classifications, rejections, or fail-safe handling and never invent protocol state.
- Lane placement names the visible touchpoint; exact transition authority remains in the normative protocol tuple.
- Continuity surrounds any persisted primary-lifecycle point; RJM01 returns to its exact mapped node and legal continuation edge set.
- The FSM remains the exhaustive legal-state authority; this FLOW is the Director-centred cognitive projection.
